entries.before:
The weather has become [CS:E]Sunny[CR]!
Fire-type moves are boosted, and Water-type
moves are weakened.
entries.en:
The weather has become [CS:E]Sunny[CR]!
Fire-type move power is multiplied by 1.2.
Water-type moves are weakened.
entries.ko:
날씨가 [CS:E]쾌청[CR]해졌다!
불꽃 기술의 위력이 1.2배가 되고
물 기술은 약해진다.

entries.before:
The weather has become a [CS:E]Sandstorm[CR]!
All Pokémon except for Ground-, Rock-, and
Steel-type Pokémon will receive damage.
entries.en:
A [CS:E]Sandstorm[CR] is blowing!
Ground, Rock and Steel types gain 1.2 times
Defense and Sp. Def. Other types take damage.
entries.ko:
[CS:E]모래바람[CR]이 불기 시작했다!
땅·바위·강철 타입의 방어·특방이 1.2배가 된다.
그 밖의 타입은 날씨 피해를 받는다.

entries.before:
The weather has become [CS:E]Rainy[CR]!
The power of Water-type moves is boosted,
and Fire-type moves are weakened.
entries.en:
The weather has become [CS:E]Rainy[CR]!
Water-type move power is multiplied by 1.2.
Fire-type moves are weakened.
entries.ko:
[CS:E]비[CR]가 내리기 시작했다!
물 기술의 위력이 1.2배가 되고
불꽃 기술은 약해진다.

entries.before:
The weather has become [CS:E]Hail[CR]!
All Pokémon except Ice-type Pokémon will
receive damage.
entries.en:
[CS:E]Snow[CR] is falling!
Ice types gain 1.2 times Defense and Sp. Def.
Snow does not cause periodic damage.
entries.ko:
[CS:E]설경[CR]이 펼쳐졌다!
얼음 타입의 방어·특방이 1.2배가 된다.
설경은 주기적인 피해를 주지 않는다.

entries.before:
The weather has become [CS:E]Snow[CR]!
The Movement Speed of Ice-type Pokémon is
boosted by 1 level.
entries.en:
[CS:E]Snow[CR] is falling!
Ice types gain 1.2 times Defense and Sp. Def.
Snow does not cause periodic damage.
entries.ko:
[CS:E]설경[CR]이 펼쳐졌다!
얼음 타입의 방어·특방이 1.2배가 된다.
설경은 주기적인 피해를 주지 않는다.

entries.en:
A [CS:E]Strong Sandstorm[CR] is blowing!
Ground, Rock and Steel types gain 1.5 times
Defense and Sp. Def.
entries.ko:
[CS:E]강한 모래바람[CR]이 불기 시작했다!
땅·바위·강철 타입의
방어·특방이 1.5배가 된다.

entries.en:
[CS:E]Strong Snow[CR] is falling!
Ice types gain 1.5 times Defense and Sp. Def.
Snow does not cause periodic damage.
entries.ko:
[CS:E]강한 설경[CR]이 펼쳐졌다!
얼음 타입의 방어·특방이 1.5배가 된다.
설경은 주기적인 피해를 주지 않는다.

entries.en:
The strong weather prevented
a change to ordinary weather!
entries.ko:
강한 날씨 때문에
일반 날씨로 바꿀 수 없었다!
